Using the web components, how do I make a Taproot button submit its form? Give me the exact attribute and value.

Use `type="submit"`, but I couldn't confirm this against Taproot's docs or your project's installed package, so it's based on the native `<button>` convention that web component libraries typically follow.

```html
<form>
  <!-- Replace with Taproot's actual button tag -->
  <taproot-button type="submit">Save</taproot-button>
</form>
```

The tag name above is a placeholder. To confirm the attribute, check the button's entry in your Taproot package or docs. If the form doesn't submit, make sure the button is inside the `<form>` and check whether the docs mention any additional form setup.
